jobs.title: Application Support Analyst – L1 Technical Support & Customer Experience
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a Application Support & Customer Experience Analyst will serve as the primary user-facing support to ensure prompt acknowledgement of requests, accurate ticket creation, effective initial triage, and clear communication through resolution.

The position is designed to improve customer experience and user confidence while reducing the coordination burden on the offshore team, enabling technical specialists to focus on faster issue resolution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Distribution List Monitoring:** Monitor assigned distribution lists during EST coverage hours and respond to all support requests promptly and professionally.
* **Ticket Creation and Administration:** Create complete and accurate tickets in the designated service management platform, capturing the issue description, business impact, priority, user details, evidence, and troubleshooting already performed.
* **Response SLA:** Provide an initial acknowledgement to the user within 15 minutes of receiving a request and communicate the ticket number, ownership, and next step.
* **First-Level Support:** Perform initial diagnosis and provide approved workarounds or standard resolutions when applicable.
* **Triage:** Support issue triage during onsite hours by validating severity, gathering logs and screenshots, reproducing issues where possible, and routing tickets to the appropriate resolver group.
* **User Perception Management:** Maintain a positive user experience through clear, courteous, and proactive communication, including requests received through direct Microsoft Teams messages.
* **Resolution Coordination:** Track open tickets, obtain progress updates from technical teams, communicate realistic timelines, and ensure users are informed through closure.
* **Offshore Handoff:** Prepare concise, actionable handoffs for the offshore team, including current status, troubleshooting completed, business impact, pending actions, owner, and priority.
* **Knowledge Management:** Document recurring issues, workarounds, troubleshooting steps, and known errors in Confluence or the approved knowledge repository.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify recurring request patterns, communication gaps, and opportunities to improve support processes, self-service content, and response efficiency.

**Service and Communication Expectations**

* Acknowledge all incoming requests within the 15-minute response SLA.
* Use a professional, empathetic, and concise communication style across email, distribution lists, tickets, and Microsoft Teams.
* Set clear expectations without committing to unconfirmed resolution times.
* Provide regular updates based on ticket priority and business impact, even when there is no material technical change.
* Confirm user acceptance before closure whenever required by the support process.
* Escalate high-impact, aging, or at-risk requests according to the agreed escalation matrix.
* Excellent verbal and written communication
* Customer-focused mindset, attention to detail, ownership, and a proactive approach to follow-up

Work Location: In person

Recognized by Forbes Magazine as one of America’s Best-In-State Credit Unions in 2025, Teachers has grown into one of the nation’s leading credit unions. Reviews loan files, system data, and credit reporting for accuracy and compliance; documents and coordinates corrections; conducts post-closing reverifications and credit dispute responses; and reports quality control findings to management.

jobs.title: Compliance & Risk Analyst
jobs.description:
Interoceanic Corporation (IOC) is a diversified group of businesses spanning industrial chemicals, fertilizers, logistics, lawn and garden products, ice melt, and private investments. We combine established industry experience with an entrepreneurial approach to business growth. Employees work across different companies and functions and have opportunities to contribute beyond a narrow job description.

**Position Overview**

IOC is seeking an inquisitive, analytical, and motivated Compliance & Risk Analyst to help build and strengthen our corporate compliance function. This newly created position offers exposure to customer and vendor due diligence, credit analysis, financial monitoring, regulatory compliance, and commercial agreements. Rather than focusing on one narrow responsibility, you will learn how a diversified business operates and how commercial decisions are made. We are looking for someone who enjoys investigating information, spotting inconsistencies, asking the right questions, and turning data into meaningful insights.

The position offers exposure to credit decisions, customer relationships and senior management priorities, with room to expand responsibilities as the function develops.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Customer and vendor due diligence: Research and screen new and existing counterparties for potential compliance, financial, and reputational risks; support onboarding, documentation checks, sanctions and restricted-party screening, and escalation of red flags.
* Credit risk and customer analysis: Monitor credit limits, outstanding exposures, and payment performance; analyze overdue balances and behavior trends; help prepare credit review reports and recommendations under established approval procedures.
* Leadership reporting: Prepare clear reporting for senior management, including the CEO, on customer payment behavior, emerging risks, and significant issues requiring attention.
* Cross-functional coordination: Work with Finance, Treasury, Sales, Legal, and Operations to resolve open issues and keep information moving.
* Agreements and corporate controls: Track commercial agreements, renewals, obligations, and compliance requirements; maintain customer, vendor, lease, charter, trademark, and patent records and coordinate specialized review as appropriate.
* Reporting and process improvement: Create dashboards, exception logs, and tracking tools; support contract-management software, automated alerts, and improved workflows.

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, business, accounting, economics, legal studies, or a related field preferred.
* Recent graduates and early-career professionals with strong analytical skills encouraged to apply.
* Investigative mindset, curiosity, and interest in how businesses operate.
* Strong Excel skills and comfort with financial data and reporting tools.
* Excellent organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.
* Confidence asking questions, identifying concerns, and communicating findings.

  

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
* Health, dental, and vision insurance.
* Retirement savings plan with company match.
* Career development and training opportunities.
* Friendly and collaborative work environment.
  

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may perform other related duties to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

  

*Interoceanic Corporation (IOC) is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.*

jobs.title: HR Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
Responsibilities:

The HR Compliance Analyst supports Related’s HR Compliance function across a multi-state workforce, helping ensure our policies, practices, and processes adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and internal standards and proactively identify and mitigate compliance risks. The role sits at the intersection of HR and Legal, with hands-on exposure to employment law, litigation support, background screening, and immigration compliance. This position is full-time, reports to the HR Compliance Manager, and will be based in our New York office three days a week. Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Regulatory & Policy Compliance

* Monitor new and existing federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations, and summarize key changes and their impact for the team.
* Maintain compliance calendar and tracker (e.g., statutory deadlines and effective dates).
* Gather data and ensure accuracy for regulatory reports.
* Oversee labor law poster process (e.g., ordering posters, coordinating with business stakeholders, and processing invoices).
* Coordinate OSHA and workers’ compensation poster process with internal stakeholders.
* Support policy and handbook review, updates, and rollout, including state-specific supplements and translations.
* Draft guidance memos for internal stakeholders on new and changing state and local requirements
* Assist with vetting and onboarding third party vendors.
* Monitor and track third party vendor and outside counsel invoices against budgets.
* Support background check compliance across multiple jurisdictions, including preparing fair chance notices within required timelines.
* Assist with the development of clear and engaging training content on evolving regulations and policy refreshers for internal stakeholders.
* Provide general support for compliance-specific projects (e.g., self-audits, tracking deadlines and responses, organizing meetings, and initiating follow up).

Employee Agreements & Employment Litigation

* Prepare, distribute, and track litigation hold notices, acknowledgments, and releases.
* Draft severance agreements and separation letters using approved templates.
* Track severance and settlement payment deadlines, including signatures and revocation periods, and coordinate with Payroll.
* Pull and prepare employee files in response to subpoenas, agency requests, and employee requests to inspect personnel records.
* Gather documents and information to support responses to agency charges (e.g., EEOC and state and local human rights agencies) and pending litigation.

Immigration & Work Authorization

* Partner with HR Operations/Talent Acquisition teams on Form I-9, E-Verify, and visa-related work authorization compliance processes.
* Monitor and track regulatory changes affecting visa holders.
* Track visa and work authorization expiration dates for employer-sponsored visas.
* Assist with self-audits for I-9/visa paperwork.
* Coordinate I-9/visa training with immigration counsel and internal stakeholders.

**Compensation**

The anticipated base salary range for this position is listed below. In addition to a competitive base salary, you will be eligible to receive discretionary bonus incentives and a comprehensive benefits package.

Anticipated base salary range: $80,000 - $100,000

Actual base salary within the anticipated range will be determined by several components including, but not limited to, the individual's experience, skills, qualifications, and market factors.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree.
* 1-3 years of relevant experience in HR, Compliance, or a related field involving a similar skill set.
* Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities and shift direction easily.
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to draft clear, accurate memos, notices, and correspondence.
* Strong interpersonal skills with ability to work across all levels within the organization.
* Professional, diplomatic, and comfortable handling sensitive and confidential information.
* Self-starter, resourceful, and able to work independently and collaboratively.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel; experience with an HRIS (e.g., UKG) a plus.
* Comfort using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to draft, research, and streamline work, paired with the judgment to verify outputs.
* Familiarity with multi-state employment law, background check requirements, severance agreements, or immigration compliance a plus.

Overview:

Formed in 1972, Related is the most prominent privately owned real estate firm in the United States. Headquartered in New York City, the company has offices and major developments across the world. Related owns and manages a premier portfolio of assets valued at over $100 billion, including the 28-acre Hudson Yards neighborhood on Manhattan’s West Side.

Related believes in investing in its talent and cultivates a positive, team-oriented environment where every voice is valued. Employees are encouraged to boldly take on new challenges, transcend the status quo, and demonstrate strong entrepreneurial spirit. In its relentless commitment to excellence, Related works to foster an innovative approach in its team members so that they can positively impact the communities in which they conduct business. Learn more about Related at www.related.com.

We complement our extensive line of Motive Power and Energy Systems with a full range of integrated services and systems. **Job Purpose**

The Inventory Analyst supports inventory accuracy, valuation, reporting, controls, and working capital performance across manufacturing, warehouse, and distribution operations. The role partners with Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, Procurement, Manufacturing, Planning, and Logistics to improve inventory visibility, identify risk, resolve discrepancies, and strengthen data-driven decision making. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capability, attention to detail, ERP and reporting knowledge, and an understanding of inventory management and accounting processes. This individual demonstrates ownership, disciplined follow-through, and a continuous improvement mindset.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

* Inventory Reporting: Monitor and analyze raw material, work-in-process, finished goods, and inventory-in-transit balances. Prepare timely weekly and monthly inventory reporting, dashboards, and performance commentary.
* Inventory Accuracy: Analyze book-to-physical differences, transaction errors, negative inventory, location discrepancies, and other exceptions. Coordinate root-cause analysis and track corrective actions through completion.
* Cycle Counts & Physical Inventory: Monitor and audit cycle count and physical inventory activities to ensure compliance with company policies, inventory control procedures, and SOX requirements. Review count variances, identify control gaps, support corrective actions, and provide reporting and analysis to management.
* Aging, Excess & Obsolete Inventory: Prepare inventory aging and slow-moving analyses. Support the identification, review, and disposition of excess and obsolete inventory and maintain documentation supporting reserve recommendations.
* Working Capital: Partner with Supply Chain and Operations to improve inventory turns, reduce aged and excess inventory, and track inventory reduction actions and financial benefits.
* Inventory Accounting: Support month-end close, inventory reconciliations, reserve calculations, inventory valuation reviews, and analysis of inventory-related balance sheet and income statement activity.
* Standard Cost & Variance Analysis: Support standard cost maintenance and annual cost-roll activities. Analyze purchase price, usage, production, scrap, yield, and overhead-related inventory variances as assigned.
* Controls & Compliance: Execute and document inventory controls in accordance with company policy, SOX requirements, stock count procedures, and audit expectations. Support internal and external audit requests.
* Data, ERP & EDW: Maintain and validate inventory and operational master data. Identify data-quality issues and support ERP, EDW, reporting, and process-integration improvements.
* Business Partnership: Collaborate with Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, Procurement, Manufacturing, Planning, Logistics, and IT to resolve inventory issues and improve end-to-end processes.
* Process Improvement: Standardize reporting, automate recurring analyses, document procedures, and recommend practical improvements that strengthen accuracy, visibility, control, and accountability.

------------------

* 3+ years of experience in inventory analysis, supply chain analytics, cost accounting, manufacturing finance, operations, or a related discipline.
* Experience in a manufacturing, warehouse, or distribution environment preferred.
* Working knowledge of inventory accounting, inventory controls, cycle counts, physical inventories, reconciliations, and reserve concepts.
* Experience with ERP systems; SAP experience preferred.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills; experience with Power Query, Power BI, or similar reporting tools preferred.

Cataloging/Metadata Analyst

Master’s degree (foreign equivalent or higher). Three (3) years of full-time relevant professional experience. Experience in metadata creation, original cataloging, metadata management, or related content services work in an academic library, research library, archives, or comparable cultural heritage organization. Experience working with library/archives management systems, digital repository platforms, or related technologies.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications:**  
Experience with Alma (Library Management System) and OCLC Connexion. Knowledge of archival/library standards including DACS, EAD, MODS, MARC21, Dublin Core, authority control and controlled vocabularies. Demonstrated interest in leveraging emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI). Participation in/contributions to the cataloging and metadata communities (national/international). Experience working with diverse formats and subject areas. Experience in creating authority records.  
  
**Brief Description of Duties:**  
The Cataloging/Metadata Analyst supports the acquisition, description, discovery, preservation, and accessibility of the Libraries' rare books, manuscripts, and other distinctive collections. Reporting to the Director of Special Collections and University Archives, the position contributes to archival processing, cataloging, metadata creation, public services, and departmental operations. Through high-quality archival practices and user-centered services, the Cataloging/Metadata Analyst enhances the discovery, preservation, and use of Special Collections materials.  
  
The incumbent must demonstrate the ability to learn new technologies, adapt to evolving archival and metadata standards, and work effectively in a collaborative environment with researchers, students, faculty, staff, and community members.

* Cataloging, Metadata & Archival Description:

  + Create, edit, and maintain original and enhanced catalog records (original and copy cataloging plus related authority work), archival descriptions, and metadata for rare books, manuscripts, university archives, audiovisual materials, photographs, maps, and digital collections.
  + Apply national and international cataloging, metadata, and archival description standards to ensure accurate discovery, long-term preservation, and access. Utilize AI-assisted tools, when appropriate, to enhance metadata creation, description, quality assurance, and workflow efficiency while ensuring professional review and adherence to archival/library standards.
* Archival Processing, Collections Management & Preservation

  + Arrange, describe, preserve, and rehouse archival collections in accordance with archival best practices. Prepare, maintain, and update finding aids to support collection discovery and accessibility. Perform the physical retrieval, transport, shelving, and re-shelving of archival and special collections materials. Collaborate with library departments on cataloging/metadata, preservation, digitization, interlibrary loan, and collection access initiatives to support the stewardship and accessibility of collections.
* Reference, Research & Public Services

  + Provide reference and research assistance to faculty, students, university administrators, community members, and visiting scholars through in-person, virtual, telephone, and email communications, including the identification, retrieval, and interpretation of archival and special collections materials. Supervise Special Collections reading rooms.
* Outreach, Instruction & Collection Engagement

  + Support public programming that promotes awareness and use of Special Collections and University Archives including participation in exhibitions, tours, class visits, instructional sessions, and community outreach activities.
* Student/Intern Supervision & Departmental Operations

  + Recruitment, training, supervision and evaluation of student assistants and interns; departmental operational support. Collaboration with other library departments on cataloging/metadata, preservation, digitization, ILL and collection-access initiatives; participation in cross-departmental collection projects.
* Assessment, Professional Development & Service

  + Collect and analyze departmental data for contribution to strategic planning, assessment, reporting, and documentation that supports departmental priorities and continuous improvement.
* Other duties or projects as assigned as appropriate to rank and department mission.

**Special Notes:**  
This is a full-time appointment. FLSA Exempt position, not eligible for the overtime provisions of the FLSA. Minimum salary threshold must be met to maintain FLSA exemption.  
  
In addition to the employee's base salary, this position is eligible for $4,000 UUP annual location pay, paid biweekly.

**About Metergy Solutions, LLC. (“Metergy”)**

Metergy has the energy, rapid growth and excitement of a startup, together with a rock-solid, recession-proof business that has a 45 year track record. We’re a technology company that drives huge carbon emission reductions. This is a once-in-a-career opportunity.

As one of North America’s most experienced submetering providers, Metergy has brought turnkey solutions to clients for over 45 years. Metergy supplies, installs and remotely reads meters to measure individual suite consumption of electricity, water, gas, and thermal energy in multi-residential and commercial buildings, and bills and collects for the cost of commodities and administrative charges for the services provided. Description:

**About Bankwell:**

Bankwell is a commercial bank with more than $3 billion in assets that serves the banking needs of businesses and individuals. At Bankwell, we pride ourselves on our unique ability to bring you high touch, high quality banking with the expertise and dedication of our experienced team of professionals. When it comes to business, our deep industry knowledge, flexibility and innovative treasury and financing services enable us to find the right solutions for our business and commercial clients. We’re passionate about giving back and are actively involved with many not-for-profit organizations that help shape and improve the lives of others. We’re dedicated to giving our time and talent to support the communities we serve. More about Bankwell can be found at www.mybankwell.com.

**Summary of Position:**

Bankwell is seeking a Business Application Analyst to support and expand the use of Jack Henry Enterprise Workflow (EWF) across the organization. This role serves as the liaison between business departments and technology teams, helping automate, standardize, and improve operational processes through workflow design, system integration, task automation, approvals, and reporting.

The successful candidate will work closely with department leaders and subject matter experts to understand existing processes, identify improvement opportunities, configure workflow solutions, support production workflows, and ensure workflows operate efficiently and consistently throughout the bank.

Enterprise Workflow is a configurable workflow platform that automates business processes through task management, approvals, notifications, document generation, audit tracking, and integration with Jack Henry and third-party applications. It is used across lending, deposits, treasury, operations, compliance, customer service, and human resources.

**Essential Responsibilities**

**Workflow Design and Automation**

* Develop workflow routing rules, approval paths, notifications, escalations, and task assignments.
* Modify existing workflows as operational and regulatory requirements evolve.
* Leverage pre-built workflow templates and customize solutions to meet Bankwell requirements.

**Application Support**

* Provide day-to-day support for Enterprise Workflow users.
* Troubleshoot workflow issues, failed transactions, routing problems, and integration errors.
* Monitor workflow performance and identify opportunities for optimization.
* Coordinate with Jack Henry support and third-party vendors when necessary.
* Participate in software upgrades, release testing, and functionality reviews.

**Business Process Improvement**

* Work with business units to document current-state and future-state processes.
* Recommend workflow enhancements that improve consistency, efficiency, accountability, and customer experience.
* Assist departments in adopting workflow automation and best practices.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives across banking operations.

**Workflow Administration**

* Maintain workflow configurations, queues, user assignments, business rules, and approval matrices.
* Support task assignment and workload routing across departments.
* Configure escalation rules, notifications, service-level tracking, and approval structures.
* Ensure workflows align with internal policies and operational controls.

**Integration and Data Management**

* Support integrations between Enterprise Workflow, Jack Henry applications, and other bank systems.
* Assist with workflow-triggered updates to customer records and bank applications.
* Validate workflow-related data exchange and automated maintenance functions.
* Support document generation, electronic communications, and workflow-based data updates.

**Reporting and Audit Support**

* Develop workflow reports and dashboards.
* Monitor workflow metrics, turnaround times, bottlenecks, and exception processing.
* Support auditors and compliance personnel by providing workflow history and audit documentation.
* Ensure workflow solutions maintain appropriate audit trails and process transparency.

Requirements:

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business, Finance, Operations, or equivalent experience.

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Transportation Planning and Management Division (TPM) is responsible for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods on the City's streets, supporting the larger goals of economic and social vitality for people living, working, and doing business in New York City. The Division’s responsibilities include planning, street design, technical analysis, signs, transit development, freight mobility and markings, ensuring the safety of motor vehicle occupants, pedestrians, and cyclists.
  
  
The Office of Curb Management within the Division of Transportation Planning & Management is responsible for curb policies across the city’s 6,300 miles of streets and roughly 3 million curbside parking spaces, with a focus on improving safety, reducing double parking and better managing competing demands from loading zones and deliveries to charging infrastructure and waste containerization to support safer, more efficient streets across the city
  
  
The Office of Curb Management is seeking a candidate to fill the role of Parking Data Analyst within that unit. In this role, the selected candidate will be charged with developing and implementing a citywide data collection program to examine curbside activity metrics in select neighborhoods throughout the city.
  
  
As Parking Data Analyst, the candidate will be responsible for all steps for the citywide data collection program including:
  

* Data collection planning

The candidate will work with the DOT Parking Planning and Policy team to develop the data collection plan including the neighborhoods that will be covered in the program, the metrics to collect, the methodology, and any consultant work and contracting that may be involved.
  

* Data collection

The candidate will be responsible for overseeing the actual data collection over the course of the year and managing the consultant relationship. The collection methodology will likely include data collection through timelapse cameras, manual occupancy counts, and/or license plate surveys across ten to twelve neighborhoods in New York City.
  

* Data processing

The candidate will be responsible for overseeing the processing of the data to ensure the capture of appropriate metrics. **Description:**

  

**Position Summary:** The Office of District Planning (ODP) is responsible for the development and implementation of district and borough based plans that address local needs and priorities with the goal of increasing access for all families to high quality educational options. These plans, developed in close partnership with superintendents, Community Education Councils (CECs), and local stakeholders, may include the opening of new schools, reconfigurations or re-sitings of existing schools, zoning changes, or openings of specialized programs (e.g. District 75, Autism NEST, Horizon and AIMS programs, etc.), among other levers.

  

The District Planning Analyst collaborates closely with the Director of District Planning and the District Planner(s) and/or Planning Coordinator(s) within one or more assigned Borough Planning Team(s) to translate complex educational datasets into actionable strategic insights. In this role, the District Planning Analyst synthesizes demographic, enrollment, admissions, and space utilization data to identify critical trends, models school level planning scenarios, and designs data tools to support the development of school utilization and rezoning proposals under Chancellor’s Regulations A-190 and A-185 as well as in compliance with New York State class size law mandates. The Analyst supports the Borough Planning Team during engagements with impacted stakeholders, such as community meetings and CEC presentations, to conduct ad hoc research on data trends, prepare analyses, and data visualizations, and help formulate responsive proposals. Performs related work.

  

**Reports to:** Director, Analytics & Data Management

  

**Direct Reports:** N/A

  

**Key Relationships:** Works closely with other members of the Borough Planning Team and Analytics Team in District Planning as well as cross functional groups, including the Office of New School Development & Design (ONS), the Office of Student Enrollment (OSE), the Office of Space Management (OSM), the School Construction Authority (SCA), Office of Legal Services (OLS), and the Office of the First Deputy Chancellor (OFDC). Also develops relationships with key external stakeholders across the borough, including Community Superintendents, CECs, Community Boards, elected officials, principals, School Leadership Teams (SLTs) and Parent Associations to gather input in the decision making process.

  

**Responsibilities**

  

Data Management & Analysis

  

* Generates and compiles data for legally mandated processes under Chancellor's Regulations A-190 and A-185, including the development and iteration on zone maps and projecting the impact of school utilization proposals and re-zonings.
* Analyzes complex demographic, enrollment, and admissions datasets to identify critical trends, producing actionable insights that inform short and long term district planning and school sustainability efforts.
* Supports building and maintenance of interactive dashboards and geographic mapping assets, integrating disparate data sources to ensure high quality, user friendly tools for both internal and external stakeholders.
Synthesizes quantitative and qualitative findings and delivers data driven recommendations and briefings directly to the Director of Analytics and Data Management.  

Team Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement

  

* Supports the Borough Planning Team during community meetings and CEC presentations throughout the school year to investigate district and school level trends and develop policy recommendations that address those needs.
* Presents complex data findings to stakeholders, responds to questions, and supports decision making through clear interpretation of district and school level trends.
* Collaborates across the ODP Analytics Team to align analytical tools, dashboards, GIS maps, and predictive models with agency priorities.
* Helps build and maintain standardized data tools, model complex planning scenarios, and provide training and technical troubleshooting to ensure all office personnel can seamlessly translate data into actionable recommendations.
* Collaborates cross functionally with teams in ODP, partner offices, and NYCPS leadership to align data tools with broader strategic planning goals.
* Provides ongoing technical assistance, troubleshooting, and support to internal users and district/school based partners using developed tools.

* A doctorate degree from an accredited college or university with specialization in an appropriate field of physical, biological, environmental or social science and one year of full-time experience in a responsible supervisory, administrative or research capacity in the appropriate field of specialization; or

* A master's degree from an accredited college or university with specialization in an appropriate field of physical, biological, environmental or social science and three years of responsible full-time research experience in the appropriate field of specialization; or

**Job Description**
-------------------

The New York City Housing Authority (NYCHA) is the nation’s oldest and largest public housing authority with more than 177,000 apartments, and responsibility for administering a citywide Section 8 leased housing program that serves over 150,000 additional tenants. NYCHA’s mission is to provide quality housing for New Yorkers that is sustainable, inclusive, and safe, while fostering opportunities for economic mobility.
  
  
NYCHA’s Asset & Capital Management (A&CM) Division leads the Authority’s capital, sustainability and resiliency programs that comprise a $6 billion capital projects portfolio - one of the largest in NY State - as well as a range of activities related to property modernization and strategic asset management. A&CM aims to preserve and modernize NYCHA buildings and apartments through strategic portfolio planning, comprehensive design standards, innovative financing and project delivery models, strong partnership with NYCHA residents and other stakeholders, and effective program and project management of capital investments. The Division also positions NYCHA’s housing portfolio for the future by piloting and scaling-up sustainable and resilient technologies and practices, improving residents’ quality of life while enhancing building performance. The work culture of the Division is strongly customer service oriented, collaborative and delivery-focused.
  
  
Strategic Services comprises five diverse teams who provide key business services and drive operational excellence across A&CM. Core functions of Strategic Services include: leading capital planning and financial administration including cost estimating for capital projects; supporting business departments to apply best-practice project management and project controls frameworks; enabling strategic vendor and contract management services; providing business intelligence services across the division to ensure data-driven management and decision-making; and, supporting business operations through supporting human resources management and logistics administration.
  
  
The A&CM Division’s Vendor & Contract Management Department seeks a Contract & Procurement Analyst. As a key member of the Applied AI and Enablement Team, the AI Enablement Analyst acts as the primary point of contact for AI initiatives across the organization. The Alternative Risk Transfer practice creates one-of-a-kind risk transfer solutions that address the needs of our large and sophisticated clients. These tailor-made risk financing solutions are a key response to some of the limitations of traditional insurance markets, which include:

* Accessing additional or complimentary capacity
* Creating certainty of cost and coverage over a multiyear term
* Facilitating risk financing while protecting the P&L / Balance Sheet
* Creating solutions when the traditional market is unavailable or deemed inefficient

jobs.description:
**Workflow Transformation Analyst – Process Innovation COE**

**Role Overview**

Pearson is fundamentally reimagining how educational products are built, from first concept through learner impact. The Workflow Transformation Analyst is a driving force in that reinvention—a hands-on change agent who doesn’t just map today’s processes but architects tomorrow’s. Embedded within our new Process Innovation COE, you will partner with Product Management, Engineering, Content Development, Production, QA, and Operations to dismantle legacy bottlenecks, design AI-native workflows, and stand up scalable operating models that dramatically accelerate speed to market and quality at scale. If you’re the kind of person who sees a broken process and can’t rest until it’s been rebuilt from the ground up—this role was made for you.

**What You’ll Own & Drive**

* Tear apart end-to-end workflows across content creation, production, QA, and release—then redesign them for radical efficiency, eliminating handoff waste and compressing cycle times.
* Architect next-generation operating models and workflow blueprints that become the gold standard across Pearson’s product portfolio—not incremental tweaks, but step-change transformations.
* Be the tip of the spear on AI-native workflow design—identify and implement high-impact automation opportunities using generative AI, agentic AI, and intelligent tooling to replace manual, error-prone work with scalable, self-improving systems.
* Drive the delivery of digital content and online course programs with urgency and accountability—owning outcomes, not just timelines.
* Own the full initiative lifecycle—planning, dependency mapping, risk mitigation, and delivery health—with a bias toward unblocking teams and accelerating momentum, not administering status reports.
* Rally and align matrixed, cross-functional teams around shared transformation goals—building coalitions, not just coordinating calendars.
* Lead high-energy workshops, transformation sprints, and workflow deep dives that produce concrete, implementable change—not slide decks that gather dust.
* Hunt for and unlock cross-Business Unit synergies—reusable patterns, shared tooling, and common operating models that multiply impact beyond any single team.
* Establish transparent, data-driven progress tracking that keeps transformation initiatives honest and on the rails—surfacing risks early and driving corrective action fast.

**What Makes You a Fit**

* Deep expertise in workflow design, process transformation, and operating model architecture—you’ve redesigned how work gets done, not just documented it.
* A track record of leading cross-functional transformation initiatives in complex, matrixed organizations—managing dependencies, breaking logjams, and shipping results.
* Exceptional communication and influence skills—you can sell a new way of working to skeptics and energize teams around bold change.
* Hands-on fluency with Agile, Scrum, or hybrid delivery models—and the judgment to know when to flex the framework.
* Proficiency with modern workflow and collaboration tooling (Jira, Smartsheet, Confluence, SharePoint, Teams) and a hunger to push beyond them.
* Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts and practical experience applying generative AI and prompt engineering to real business workflows.
* Technical literacy (HTML, scripting, or low-code platforms) sufficient to prototype and validate automation ideas—you don’t just spec it, you prove it.
* You thrive in ambiguity, move fast when others are paralyzed, and bring contagious energy to high-stakes transformation work.

**Education**

Bachelor’s degree required (or equivalent practical experience).

**How We’ll Measure Impact**

* Measurable reduction in end-to-end cycle times for content creation and product delivery.
* Elimination (not just reduction) of manual, error-prone steps through automation and AI-enabled workflows.
* New operating models adopted at scale across multiple Business Units—not pilot-only wins.
* On-time, high-quality delivery of transformation initiatives with clear before/after evidence of impact.
* Stakeholders actively requesting your involvement on their next initiative—the ultimate proof of value.

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer, Semantic Layer
jobs.description:
Cloaked is building a cyber expert at your side - one that watches, advises, and acts to keep you safe and private in the age of AI. 600k+ paying members already use Cloaked to take back control of their data, their identity, and who can reach them: masked emails, phone numbers, and payment cards, data removal from broker sites, and an AI voice agent that screens calls before they ring through.

We've protected 10M+ identities, screened 50M+ calls, and removed 1B+ records from the data brokers who profit off personal information. Backed by a $375M Series B, we're now building the agents that turn detection into action - for individuals, families, and the companies that want to protect their people.

**About the Role**

We're looking for an **Analytics Engineer** to own the semantic layer at Cloaked - the governed set of metrics, entities, and relationships behind every dashboard, self-serve analysis, and AI-driven answer across the company. Every number at Cloaked should mean the same thing, no matter who asks or which tool they use. You'll make that true.

This is a builder's role. You'll turn ambiguous business questions into durable, well-tested definitions that both people and AI agents can rely on, working closely with the Data team and partners across Product, Growth, Finance, and CX.

**What will you do?**

* Design, build, and maintain the semantic layer, including metric definitions, dimensions, joins, and entity relationships across product, subscription, and lifecycle data
* Build and maintain BI artifacts - models, explores, and dashboards - on top of the semantic layer for teams across the company
* Build and curate certified metrics and queries that power AI-assisted, natural-language data querying, and improve answer accuracy over time
* Partner with stakeholders to resolve conflicting metric definitions and document the agreed source of truth
* Write clean, tested, version-controlled SQL and transformation code with data quality checks and clear documentation
* Work closely with data engineering on upstream models, and with analysts on how the layer gets used

**What skills and experiences will help you?**

* 3-5 years of experience in analytics engineering, BI engineering, or a closely related role
* Strong SQL and solid dimensional data modeling skills
* Hands-on experience building semantic models in a tool like Looker (LookML), Omni, dbt Semantic Layer, or Cube (we care more about the modeling fundamentals than any specific tool)
* Experience with dbt or a similar transformation framework, Git-based workflows, and code review
* Familiarity with cloud data platforms (AWS/Athena, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar)
* AI-forward: you use AI tooling (Claude, ChatGPT, and others) fluently to ship faster, and you're excited to structure data that AI agents query directly. Experience building semantic models for LLM-driven analytics is a plus, not a requirement
* Clear communication, and comfort pushing back on a vague metric until it's well defined

**What do we like?**

* **Demand Clarity** - push back on a vague metric until it's well defined. Then…
* **Build Value** - we ship insights and value to our stakeholders over fancy tech / dashboards.
* A value add mindset. Cloaked is hungry for insights. We must feed everyone with data.
* Startup or growth-stage company experience
* Care and respect for our customers' privacy as if it were your own
* **“Work hard and be nice to people”** is a way of working. Not nice to have.

**What we offer**
-----------------

Cloaked is a well-funded Series B startup based out of NYC.  
  
Although we are a distributed team, the NYC team operates with a hybrid model. We have two floors of our building, with two state of the art kitchens packed with drinks, snacks and everything else you'd need to get through the day.  
  
The Cloaked team has diverse interests and so we frequently embark on team outings and go out for socials!

**Compensation and Benefits**
-----------------------------

We offer above market rate pay and equity based off of the market's best commercially available data. Your compensation will be a combination of salary, bonus and equity.  
  
For full-time US employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package: medical, dental and vision with Cloaked covering the majority of employee premiums, company-paid basic life, and a 401(k) with company match.  
  
We offer flexible work arrangements and the ability to work remotely as needed. Cloaked provides a home office stipend in addition to a new company laptop (and other tech depending on the role).

**Perks**
---------

**Competitive PTO:** PTO, floating holidays and sick days - and we push people to actually use them. We see time off as a preventative burnout measure, not a balance to hoard.

**Parental Leave:** Paid leave for all new parents - birth, adoption, or foster placement - because the people building privacy deserve time with their families.

**Monthly wellness & meals stipend:** Used for any kind of physical, mental or emotional care you'd like to take for yourself, be it a gym membership, a meditation app, or time with a personal trainer - plus lunch and coffee during the workday.

**Professional Growth:** Opportunities for career development and personal growth are provided to all employees who seek to further their knowledge and capabilities through an unlimited professional development fund. jobs.title: Trade CRM Specialist
jobs.description:
### **Position**

**Are you ready for a world of possibilities?**

You embark on a career journey with the leaders of luxury wines, champagnes, and spirits, within the prestigious LVMH Group. From nature to communities, you’ll craft unforgettable experiences that drive the collective success of our 26 Maisons – each one with a unique heritage and set within the most remarkable terroirs the world has to offer. **You enter a world of possibility** where career development opportunities across our Maisons, our 5 global regions, and the entire LVMH Group, are unmatched. You **join a passionate community of talents** that spans four generations and combines a wealth of roles and skillsets from the roots of the vine to the glass and everything in between **. You discover our essential** **relationship** with our terroirs, and how we nurture and preserve the soils which are the source of our singular products. Our global Living Soils Living Together program has four key commitments for 2030: regenerating soils, mitigating our climate impact, engaging society, and empowering our people **. You will share in our passion** for hosting, for art-de-vivre as well as our pride in creating products that celebrate life’s most memorable milestones, while always experienced through measured, responsible tasting.

**Moët Hennessy** is proud to promote a diverse, equitable and inclusive working environment for all. As an employer, Moët Hennessy offers unique journeys throughout its global ecosystem, opportunities to develop new skills and grow professionally. If you want to inspire and be inspired, to craft experiences and experience the best in craftsmanship, this is where you’ll flourish.

The Trade CRM Specialist is a change enablement role that combines strategic, analytical, and operational responsibilities, with a strong focus on user support, training, and adoption of MHUSA’s Trade CRM ecosystem, known internally as ASPIRE, which combines Salesforce for customer relationship management and sales execution with Power BI for reporting, analytics, and data visualization. The role helps Commercial teams effectively leverage these platforms to streamline day-to-day activities, improve customer engagement, and drive more informed, data-driven decision-making.

Working cross-functionally with internal stakeholders, the Trade CRM Specialist serves as a key resource for end users, providing ongoing training, troubleshooting, and guidance to maximize platform adoption and business value. The role also supports the development of actionable dashboards, reporting capabilities, and analytics aligned with MHUSA’s commercial priorities, while promoting best practices and continuous improvement across the organization.

***Office/Location: Hybrid 3x a week based out of*** ***NYC Office***

Compensation: $67,000-$80,000/ Annually + Bonus

### **Job responsibilities**

**Role and Responsibilities**

**1.** **User Training, Support & Adoption**

Serve as a primary resource for day-to-day user support across ASPIRE, Power BI, and related reporting tools. Lead new-user onboarding, deliver ongoing training, troubleshoot functional issues, and develop practical learning materials, including presentations, videos, and quick-reference guides. Support platform rollouts and adoption initiatives, helping users confidently navigate systems, access reports, and incorporate these tools into their daily workflows.

**2.** **Platform Optimization & Continuous Improvement**

Gather and document business requirements and relevant information to effectively triage, troubleshoot, and resolve system issues in collaboration with technical teams. Coordinate testing, validation, and implementation of bug fixes and enhancements, while maintaining clear and timely communication with impacted users and departments throughout the resolution process. Ensure issues are tracked through completion. Identify opportunities to improve platform functionality, streamline workflows, and enhance the user experience.

  

**3.** **Performance Analytics & Reporting**

Develop, maintain, and enhance Power BI dashboards, Salesforce reports, and analytical tools that provide actionable insights into Commercial performance. Monitor key performance indicators, evaluate sales execution and activation effectiveness, and conduct trend and root cause analyses to identify performance gaps and opportunities for improvement. Ensure reporting aligns with business priorities and supports informed decision-making across the organization.

**4.** **Data Stewardship & Quality Assurance**

Support data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across Salesforce and Power BI. Investigate data discrepancies, identify underlying issues, and coordinate with Data and IT teams on resolution. Promote data quality standards and best practices to ensure reliable reporting and maintain confidence in the underlying information.

**5.** **Data Analytics Best Practices**

Promote a data-driven culture by sharing analytical best practices, collaborating with other analysts/specialists, and helping stakeholders build their understanding of available tools and insights. Contribute to MHUSA's broader analytics community and support the adoption of consistent reporting methodologies and performance measurement standards across teams.

### **Profile**

**Education:**

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

Additional certifications or training in Salesforce, Microsoft Power BI, or data analytics are a plus.

**Professional Experience:**

2+ years of professional experience in sales, marketing, business analytics, or a related field. Experience in the wine and spirits industry is a plus.

**Practical/Technical Knowledge:**

* Hands-on experience working with Salesforce CRM, including user support, reporting, and platform functionality.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft

jobs.description:

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. ### **You’ll need to have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Math, Physics, Computer Science, and Engineering.
* Experience with Google Cloud platform or Looker.
* Experience with Google Apps scripts.
* Experience with advanced analytics via Minitab, Python, or R Studio.
* Balanced the needs of multiple partners.
* Product development or analytics experience in the technology sector.
* Business Intelligence Certification (CPBI).

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above

### **Where you’ll be working**

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

### **Scheduled Weekly Hours**

40

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

jobs.description:
The **Insights Lead, Brand & Consumer Analytics** will play a critical role in transforming data into actionable business insights across Brand and Consumer-focused initiatives. This role expands the capabilities of the existing Analytics team, complementing the current onshore leads responsible for Commercial & Digital Commerce (.com) analytics and Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) & Forecasting.

As a strategic thought partner, this individual will lead deep-dive analyses that uncover opportunities, identify drivers of performance, and translate complex findings into clear business recommendations. They will develop trusted relationships with key client stakeholders across Marketing, IT, Sales, and Finance, while also collaborating closely with internal Accenture teams supporting brand and consumer marketing initiatives.

The successful candidate will connect insights across Brand, Consumer, MMM, Commercial, and Digital Commerce workstreams to deliver a holistic view of business performance. A key expectation of this role is the ability to move beyond reporting what happened to articulating why it happened, what it means for the business, and what actions should be taken next.

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead advanced analytics and insight generation for Brand and Consumer initiatives.
* Develop compelling, data-driven narratives that influence decision-making and business strategy.
* Translate complex analytical findings into actionable recommendations for executive and stakeholder audiences.
* Partner with client and internal teams to identify opportunities, solve business challenges, and drive measurable outcomes.
* Integrate insights across multiple analytics workstreams, including MMM, forecasting, commercial performance, and digital commerce.
* Elevate the quality, consistency, and business relevance of analytical deliverables and executive communications.

  

### **Basic Qualifications**

  

* Minimum 10+ years' experience in analytics roles of increasing responsibility in media agency, and/or consulting organizations. Experience should include:
  + Strong client relationship management and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to build credibility and trust at multiple organizational levels.
  + Demonstrated expertise in data storytelling, executive presentations, and insight communication.
  + Advanced analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including knowledge of statistical methodologies and hypothesis-driven analysis.
  + Hands-on experience with data extraction, manipulation, and analysis using SQL and Python.
  + Ability to synthesize large, complex datasets into concise business insights and strategic recommendations.
  + Strong executive presence and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership audiences.
  + Experience across a variety of industries is important and B2B experience is a plus

jobs.description:
TheGuarantors is a fintech company helping multifamily owners and operators mitigate leasing risk while expanding access for renters. With a deep understanding of owner, operator, and renter needs, we believe renters deserve better access to the home of their choice and operators deserve greater protection and growth opportunities. That’s why we’re leveraging our real estate expertise and using AI-driven renter underwriting to help operators qualify renters faster while mitigating the financial risk of renter default. With $7B+ in lease value protected, we work with 9 of the country’s top 10 operators, are the #1 lease guarantee provider nationwide, and have consistently been named one of Inc. 5000’s fastest-growing companies, Forbes’ Best Startup Employers, Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500.

**Role Summary**

TheGuarantors is looking for a highly organized, systems-minded Senior Manager, Event Marketing Operations to help scale the day-to-day operations of our Event Marketing function.

Reporting to the VP of Event Marketing, this role will serve as the operational backbone of the team, translating event strategy into clear project plans, maintaining the systems that keep our work moving, and ensuring leadership has consistent visibility into timelines, budgets, capacity and performance.

This is an individual contributor role with significant cross-functional influence. The ideal candidate is a strong project manager who is comfortable operating across multiple events and workstreams at once, anticipates needs before they become issues, and brings structure to a fast-moving environment.

This person will work closely with Event Coordinators responsible for event execution while partnering with the VP of Event Marketing on strategy, approvals, quality standards and prioritization.

**What You’ll Do**

**Event Marketing Operations**

* Own and continuously improve the operating systems used to manage the Event Marketing portfolio.
* Translate approved event strategies into clear project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies and workstreams.
* Maintain a reliable view of upcoming events, key deadlines, team capacity and project health.
* Establish clear processes and documentation for how work moves through the Event Marketing team.
* Ensure the event intake and project management environment is structured, current and consistently used across the team.
* Identify opportunities to make workflows more efficient, scalable and easier for the team to operate.

**Reporting, Data & Benchmarking**

* Own the Event Marketing reporting framework and ensure event performance data is consistently captured.
* Partner with team members to maintain clean, accurate event information in HubSpot and other team systems.
* Maintain historical benchmarks across comparable events and use past performance to help establish targets for future programs.
* Ensure post-event reporting is completed consistently and accurately.

**Budget Operations**

* Own the process used to track Event Marketing budgets and spend across the portfolio.
* Ensure projected and actual event costs are current and accurate.
* Regularly review event-level spend for discrepancies or gaps before information reaches leadership.
* Provide the VP of Event Marketing with clear visibility into budget pacing, upcoming commitments and areas of risk.
* Partner with individual event owners to ensure they maintain accurate financial information for their programs.
* Conduct ROI analysis to determine best rates of return on given event skews.

**Project & Portfolio Management**

* Coordinate work across concurrent events and initiatives to ensure projects remain on schedule.

* Identify capacity constraints, dependencies and competing deadlines early and surface them for prioritization.
* Proactively communicate project progress without requiring leadership follow-up.
* Immediately escalate risks related to budget, timeline, attendee experience, vendor performance or event quality.
* When raising an issue, bring available context, potential solutions and a recommendation whenever possible.

**Event Planning & Experience Development**

* Partner with coordinators and external vendors to turn approved concepts into executable plans.
* Help maintain the premium standard associated with TheGuarantors events across every touchpoint.
* Know when a logistical decision may meaningfully affect event experience or quality and elevate it appropriately.

**Sales & Cross-Functional Enablement**

* Ensure Sales and other internal partners have clear processes, tools and information needed to successfully participate in Event Marketing programs.
* Maintain accessible event information so team members can independently find answers before escalating questions.
* Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Finance and other stakeholders to keep event programs moving effectively.

jobs.title: Lead Analytics Engineer — Payments, Identity & Trust and Safety
jobs.description:
Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd, Slideshare, Everand, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.

**Culture at Scribd, Inc.**
---------------------------

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

**About the team and role**
===========================

**The team.** Data & Analytics is building the DNA of an AI native Scribd, Inc. Bringing together Analytics Engineering, Data Science, and Data Analytics, D&A turns fragmented data and inconsistent definitions into trusted, production-quality data foundations — and builds the AI agents and analytical tools that bring reliable intelligence directly into how teams make decisions.

**The role.** This role supports the pillars that own payments, identity, security as well as trust & safety systems — the foundations that let Scribd securely monetize and protect its products. It is the senior-most analytics engineering role for these pillars and a purely technical leadership position with no direct reports. You will report to the Director, Analytics Engineering, and work embedded alongside Product Analytics, Data Science, Product, and Engineering partners.

**Mandate.** Give core business concepts one authoritative definition, and make sure the numbers survive a PSP migration, a schema change, or a new market launch without silently going wrong. For Trust & Safety, make it possible to say with confidence how much violating content exists on Scribd and how much of it users see with numbers that stay comparable as moderation models, policies, and review processes change.

**Core philosophy.** A metric definition is an engineering artifact. We care about lineage, observability, and data quality as much as the dashboard on top — because a number that quietly breaks upstream is worse than no number at all.

**About you**
=============

* You are equally comfortable as the modeler and the analyst. You can build the pipeline, define the metric, and defend the number in a room full of executives.
* You are skeptical by default. When payment success rate drops four points, your instinct is to go find the field that changed meaning, not to write the narrative. You have opinions about how payments data should be structured to prevent misleading narratives.
* You are pragmatic. You ask what the right next version is, and you use AI where it creates measurable value.
* You communicate early and plainly, and you write things down. Methodology and model documentation are part of the deliverable.

**You will**
============

* **Own the canonical data models for payments, billing, and subscriptions** in Databricks modeled once across Scribd, Everand, and Fable so a new market, or payment method doesn't require a rewrite, and built with the next engineer and the AI tools on top as explicit consumers.
* **Own the KPI and semantic layer for payments and identity** exposed through self-serve dashboaring/AI tools.
* **Extend the same discipline to Trust & Safety**, owning the models and metrics behind prevalence and exposure, including evaluation of AI-generated moderation labels.
* **Drive quality, observability, and lineage** so a regional login challenge rate change or processor routing change is caught in days, not quarters and root-cause discontinuities to separate real customer or processor behavior from migration artifacts and data quality issues.
* **Build AI tools on trusted foundations**, grounded in certified metrics and tables, kept in sync as definitions change, and validated with evaluation sets that prove the answers are right.
* **Raise the technical bar**, set modeling and metric conventions, influence source-system changes before they land, and mentor analysts and analytics engineers in these domains.

**You have**
============

* 8+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence engineering or a related discipline
* Deep, hands-on payments expertise: including direct experience with processor data from Stripe, Adyen, Braintree, PayPal, or similar.
* Practical experience with identity and authentication data
* Depth in governed, canonical data models and semantic layers, and a track record of defining a metric, defending it under scrutiny, and versioning it when its inputs changed.
* Advanced SQL and production experience with Databricks, AWS, Looker, Airbyte, Fivetran, or comparable platforms, including orchestration, transformation frameworks, and automated testing.
* Experience making data reliable for AI consumption
* Proven ability to influence senior product and engineering leaders and translate complex payment economics into clear business trade-offs.

**Nice to have**
================

* Advanced Python and experience building AI agents or LLM-based pipelines.
* E

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a Application Support & Customer Experience Analyst will serve as the primary user-facing support to ensure prompt acknowledgement of requests, accurate ticket creation, effective initial triage, and clear communication through resolution.

The position is designed to improve customer experience and user confidence while reducing the coordination burden on the offshore team, enabling technical specialists to focus on faster issue resolution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Distribution List Monitoring:** Monitor assigned distribution lists during EST coverage hours and respond to all support requests promptly and professionally.
* **Ticket Creation and Administration:** Create complete and accurate tickets in the designated service management platform, capturing the issue description, business impact, priority, user details, evidence, and troubleshooting already performed.
* **Response SLA:** Provide an initial acknowledgement to the user within 15 minutes of receiving a request and communicate the ticket number, ownership, and next step.
* **First-Level Support:** Perform initial diagnosis and provide approved workarounds or standard resolutions when applicable.
* **Triage:** Support issue triage during onsite hours by validating severity, gathering logs and screenshots, reproducing issues where possible, and routing tickets to the appropriate resolver group.
* **User Perception Management:** Maintain a positive user experience through clear, courteous, and proactive communication, including requests received through direct Microsoft Teams messages.
* **Resolution Coordination:** Track open tickets, obtain progress updates from technical teams, communicate realistic timelines, and ensure users are informed through closure.
* **Offshore Handoff:** Prepare concise, actionable handoffs for the offshore team, including current status, troubleshooting completed, business impact, pending actions, owner, and priority.
* **Knowledge Management:** Document recurring issues, workarounds, troubleshooting steps, and known errors in Confluence or the approved knowledge repository.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify recurring request patterns, communication gaps, and opportunities to improve support processes, self-service content, and response efficiency.

**Service and Communication Expectations**

* Acknowledge all incoming requests within the 15-minute response SLA.
* Use a professional, empathetic, and concise communication style across email, distribution lists, tickets, and Microsoft Teams.
* Set clear expectations without committing to unconfirmed resolution times.
* Provide regular updates based on ticket priority and business impact, even when there is no material technical change.
* Confirm user acceptance before closure whenever required by the support process.
* Escalate high-impact, aging, or at-risk requests according to the agreed escalation matrix.
* Excellent verbal and written communication
* Customer-focused mindset, attention to detail, ownership, and a proactive approach to follow-up

Associate Analyst, Business OperationsOverview  

* The Mastercard Economics Institute (MEI) is an economics lab that drives macroeconomic thought leadership in support of Mastercard’s efforts to build a more inclusive and sustainable digital economy
* The Economics Institute was launched in 2020 to analyze macroeconomic trends through the lens of the consumer to deliver tailored and actionable insights on economic issues for customers, partners and policymakers
* The Institute is composed of a team of economists and data scientists that utilize & synthesize the anonymized and aggregated data from the Mastercard network together with public data to bring powerful insights to life, in the form of 1:1 presentations, global thought leadership, media participation, and commercial work through the Economics Practice

  
About the role  
We are seeking a Business Operations Analyst to manage the implementation of MEI’s recurring operational cadence. Reporting to our Manager of Strategy and Operations, you will be responsible for ensuring the flawless execution of our operations processes, as well as escalating opportunities for improvement, and partnering with the Manager of Strategy and Operations to implement improved solutions.  
  
In this role, you will:  

* Manage the MEI calendar for the year, including internal and external engagements and meetings, major content milestones, marketing and communications collaboration, and strategy and planning timelines
* You will engage directly with our partner organizations to intake their operational cadences, so that we can map onto these (Marketing, Finance, HR, etc.)
* Organize and support weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual meeting cadences
* Support development of relevant content and deliverables for these meetings, together with the Manager for Strategy and Operations
* Coordinate with key internal and external stakeholders to document and oversee research delivery protocols (IR, Legal, Marketing, Comms, etc.)
* Coordinate with key internal and external stakeholders to maintain finance, budget, headcount and T&E processes
* Meet regularly with MEI internal managers to update central calendar, assess requirements, and surface any operational blockers for quick action – act as the internal air traffic control for problems, routing these to the appropriate places for redress. Collect requests for headcount, data, budget, and other requirements for central vetting

  
Typical deliverables include:  

* Up to date 12-month rolling calendar of research production (reports, engagements, etc.), and updates to this
* Up to date 12-month rolling calendar of MEI management (All Hands, Town Halls, QBRs, Finance Check Points, etc.) , and updates to this
* Draft agendas and draft content for meetings
* Oversite of vendor relationships including incorporation of bill cycles into finance calendar of the year
* Identification of gaps in operating procedures and proposed solutions

  
About you  

* You are enthusiastic about the field of operational excellence, and are ready to solve problems starting on day 1
* Strong process management skills – experience with design thinking a plus
* High levels of organization – you are highly reliable
* Your attention to detail is very strong
* Experience with process documentation and/or governance is a plus
* Excellent written communication skills, including strong aptitude for synthesizing information
* You are highly responsive, and understand that a quick call up front can save hours down the line
* You view exposure to a truly global team as a benefit, while recognizing the challenges of working across global time zones

  
This role is not eligible for Mastercard-sponsored work authorization. * Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

The Transportation Planning and Management Division (TPM) is responsible for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods on the City's streets, supporting the larger goals of economic and social vitality for people living, working, and doing business in New York City. The Division’s responsibilities include planning, street design, technical analysis, signs, transit development, freight mobility and markings, ensuring the safety of motor vehicle occupants, pedestrians, and cyclists.
  
  
The Office of Curb Management within the Division of Transportation Planning & Management is responsible for curb policies across the city’s 6,300 miles of streets and roughly 3 million curbside parking spaces, with a focus on improving safety, reducing double parking and better managing competing demands from loading zones and deliveries to charging infrastructure and waste containerization to support safer, more efficient streets across the city
  
  
The Office of Curb Management is seeking a candidate to fill the role of Parking Data Analyst within that unit. In this role, the selected candidate will be charged with developing and implementing a citywide data collection program to examine curbside activity metrics in select neighborhoods throughout the city.
  
  
As Parking Data Analyst, the candidate will be responsible for all steps for the citywide data collection program including:
  

* Data collection planning

The candidate will work with the DOT Parking Planning and Policy team to develop the data collection plan including the neighborhoods that will be covered in the program, the metrics to collect, the methodology, and any consultant work and contracting that may be involved.
  

* Data collection

The candidate will be responsible for overseeing the actual data collection over the course of the year and managing the consultant relationship. The collection methodology will likely include data collection through timelapse cameras, manual occupancy counts, and/or license plate surveys across ten to twelve neighborhoods in New York City.
  

* Data processing

The candidate will be responsible for overseeing the processing of the data to ensure the capture of appropriate metrics. This may include overseeing consultant processing of timelapse photos, overseeing spreadsheet/data analysis in Microsoft Excel and similar databases, and ensuring collected data is clean and mappable.
  

* Data reporting

The candidate will be responsible for writing periodic reports on the status of the data collection effort including annual reports. This will include interpreting the data collection to communicate to a both a technical and general audience, writing reports, generating charts, creating maps, and presenting to DOT leadership.
  
  
The candidate should have a solid foundation of experience in transportation planning and data collection of parking and transportation metrics. The candidate should be comfortable with and proficient in creating reports and presentations that distill complex information for both technical and non-technical audiences. The candidate should have strong experience using data analysis tools like Microsoft Excel, R, and ArcGIS. The Analyst will have latitude for independent judgement and will be relied upon to keep the Data Collection program on track, organized, and efficient. The successful candidate will also participate in the general strategic planning/problem-solving sessions and assist in the development and deployment of new technologies, programs, processes, and other strategies.
